The Strange Man's Arrival
The stranger at the Coach and Horses

Iping, West Sussex, early in February: the last snowfall of the year. You lodge at the Coach and Horses and help Mrs. Hall about the bar. Someone is coming over the down from Bramblehurst station, in the driving snow.
The road over the down, in the snow
❄️ The last snowfall

The stranger came early in February, one wintry day, through a biting wind and a driving snow, the last snowfall of the year, over the down, walking from Bramblehurst railway station, and carrying a little black portmanteau in his thickly gloved hand.
Stand on the down road and watch the muffled figure coming through the snow

🥓 A guest in winter
A guest to stop at Iping in the wintertime was an unheard-of piece of luck, let alone a guest who was no "haggler," and she was resolved to show herself worthy of her good fortune.
